channel.title: Good Measure Kitchen — Kitchen Notes
channel.description: Question-led kitchen buying guides and a sourced evidence desk.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Two shapes solve two different problems. The question is which problem you actually have.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air-fryer capacity
item.description: Quarts are a unit of volume. Portions are a unit of dinner. Here is how to move between them.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The ten minutes after dinner is the real test of a kitchen appliance.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Nine programs is a feature. Four that you will actually use is a purchase.

item.title: Do you need a thermometer to get good air-fried results?
item.description: Air fryers cook hot and fast. That is exactly when a probe earns its price.

item.title: Hosting a holiday meal with an air fryer: a realistic plan
item.description: Air fryers are the most useful thing in the kitchen and the worst thing to build an entire dinner around.

item.title: Basket air fryers
item.description: Pull-out basket formats. You choose what goes in, pull the basket, and the food comes to you at counter height.

item.title: Air fryer ovens
item.description: Oven formats with a door, racks and a cavity. More cooking modes and more counter space in exchange.

item.title: Cooking tools & thermometers
item.description: The instruments around the appliance. Included because the brief supplied one, and because a thermometer changes how an air fryer is used.
